snippet.title: Blasting OUT of Early Access on October 20 | Mycopunk 1.0 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Cut through fungal aliens in this hyper-customizable, mission-based looter shooter when Mycopunk blasts out of Early Access and lands on PC and PlayStation 5 on October 20. 

Hundreds of hand-crafted upgrades, 4-player co-op, and a little roach man. What’s not to love?
